source.start_reference: two official player portrait cutouts on neutral background

qa.surprise_review: Six footballs suddenly appear and both players react; a surprising effect is visible, but six rather than five balls makes the historical visual analogy inaccurate.
qa.visual_review: Animation of two cutout player portraits on a plain background, not a coherent photorealistic indoor scene. Five planned balls became six.
qa.audio_review: AAC track preserved; sound cannot be independently heard.
qa.outro_review: Logo, goaliq.de and exact German disclaimer visually checked.
